text:
Anya: Quick proposal — move weekly triage from Mon 11:00 to Tue 09:30 (30m). Reason: fewer calendar conflicts and earlier owner sync. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Mike: Tue 09:30 conflicts with weekly infra sync for me. Can we do Tue 10:00 instead?
Sarah: +1 to moving off Mon. I prefer 09:30, earlier helps unblock EU folks.
Oliver: If we shorten to 30m, can we carve out a recurring 10-min 'RFC spot' before the meeting for design quicklooks? Otherwise RFCs always take over.
Priya: Can we keep agenda strict: 1) High-severity bugs (10m) 2) Owner updates & assignments (10m) 3) RFC/design pings (10m). If overflow, defer to async thread. :white_check_mark:
Anya: Proposed agenda snippet:
```
- 00-10m: high-sev bugs (owner on deck)
- 10-20m: owner updates + quick decisions
- 20-30m: RFC quicklooks (3 slides / 5min max)
```
Oliver: Sounds good. I can try rotating owner week-to-week; I'll take next two.
Mike: Tue 10:00 ok for me if others fine. @Sarah @Priya?
Sarah: Tue 09:30 still preferred. Can we do Tue 09:45? middle ground.
Priya: 09:45 works for me.
Anya: Alright team — new time: Tue 09:45 weekly, 30m. Owner rotation: weekly, opt-in. I'll update the calendar and add the agenda template + pinned prompt for RFCs. :calendar:
calendar-bot: Event updated: "Engineering triage (weekly)" — Tuesdays 09:45-10:15 — Zoom link attached.
devops-bot: Reminder: set attendee owner tag in the meeting description using format `owner: @handle` so ops can follow up.
Anya: I'll post a short checklist in the triage channel for owners — call out regressions, customer-impact, and suggested fixes. Anything else?
Oliver: Maybe add a "follow-ups" thread link in the description.
Mike: Also add "blocked PRs" bullet, 1-liner max.
Priya: Great. Thanks all. See you next Tue. :rocket:
